provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

nameChecks.ja: デッドラビッツ ボス
奇妙なデッドラビッツ団員
覆われたデッドラビッツ団員
デッドラビッツ ボス？

gameLocalization.note: Guide ellipsis variants are matched to paired game records. Heart of Vengeance is scoped to these bosses to distinguish the Identity passive Grudge.

lead.text: Defeating henchmen gives the boss more slots and SP, plus buffs next turn. Handle the henchmen with clashes or Defense Skills, and let Heathcliff take clashes he can win against the boss. Stop “Upheaval” and focus damage on the boss during its Stagger at 60% HP.

listLead.text: Defeating adds gives the boss more actions and buffs. Contain the adds and stop the boss's dangerous skills instead. Concentrate damage during the first Stagger and limit time facing Counters after recovery.

statNote.text: Focused Encounter at 6-33. All enemies are Lv.44. The boss has 929 HP and Defense Level 47; the 2 Bizarre Henchmen and 1 Veiled Henchman each have 186 HP and Defense Level 36. Heathcliff is mandatory. The boss takes only 0.8× damage from all three Physical types, so also exploit Sin affinities such as Gloom and Envy. Mirror Dungeon variants are excluded.

skillNote.text: The boss has 5 skills; each henchman has 4. Their counters are regular Counters, not Clashable attacks. Distinguish “Upheaval”'s base range of 5–17 from its Rupture, Bleed, and Antagonism clash bonuses, and from its Heads Hit bonuses to later Coins. “Smackdown”'s Attack Power Up amount is unspecified; do not infer it from its 1 Damage Up.

priorities.0.text: Aim for Lv.44 and Uptie III or higher on your main team. Prioritize Identities with strong opening clashes and resistances that can withstand Blunt attacks.

priorities.1.text: Keep the henchmen alive, handle them with clashes or Defense Skills, and focus damage on the boss. If an area attack also kills henchmen, account for the extra slots and next-turn buffs.

priorities.2.text: Save a strong skill that can beat “Upheaval”. Give Heathcliff clashes he can win, and prepare enough damage to finish the boss after its Stagger at 60% HP.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The fight suddenly becomes harder after clearing the henchmen

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Each henchman's death permanently adds a boss slot for the encounter and heals it for 15 SP. If a Sinner kills the henchman, the boss also gains Attack Power Up and Haste next turn. Start by keeping the henchmen alive and handling their attacks.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: The boss heals 15 SP every turn and gains +2 Clash Power when the target's current HP exceeds its own. Use Identities with strong opening clashes, and lower the boss's SP through clashes Heathcliff can win.

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Rupture and Bleed strengthen the clash, and Coin III deals additional Pierce damage equal to Bleed Potency × Count. Save a strong skill or E.G.O for this attack, and prevent debuffs from building up on the preceding turn.

units.0.notes.0.text: Starts with 3 actions: 2 attacks and Guard. Each henchman's death adds a slot.

units.0.notes.1.text: At 60% HP or below, Guard becomes Counter. Focus damage during Stagger.

units.0.notes.2.text: The listed 0% and negative Stagger Thresholds retain the source values. The threshold normally reachable before defeat is 60%.

units.0.notes.3.text: Defeating the boss also kills the remaining henchmen.

units.1.notes.1.text: Dies when the boss is defeated. Killing it first increases the boss's slots and SP.

units.2.notes.1.text: Dies when the boss is defeated. Killing it first increases the boss's slots and SP.

phases.0.title.text: Keep the henchmen alive and stabilize clashes against the boss

phases.0.steps.0.text: Handle henchman attacks with winning clashes or Defense Skills, and direct damage at the boss. Using area attacks indiscriminately can strengthen the boss by killing its henchmen.

phases.0.steps.1.text: The boss heals 15 SP at Turn Start. Using a strong skill for a clash Heathcliff can win lowers the boss's SP by 10 and inflicts 2 Bind next turn, up to once per turn.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Offset Guard with a Defense Skill, or have another Sinner clash with an attack instead. Avoid triggering its next-turn buff unnecessarily.

phases.1.title.text: Check Rupture and Bleed, and save a strong clash

phases.1.steps.0.text: With all 3 henchmen alive, the usual Turn 3 pattern is “Upheaval” and 2 uses of “Smackdown”. Check the actual skills and reserve a strong response.

phases.1.steps.1.text: “Upheaval” gains +1 Clash Power for at least 5 Rupture on its target, and another +1 for at least 5 Bleed. Antagonism can also activate based on current HP, so do not judge it solely by the listed maximum of 17.

phases.1.steps.2.text: If using a debuffing E.G.O, check its resource costs and activation order. If a poor hand repeatedly leads to hits, review your opening clashes and team.

phases.2.title.text: Focus damage on the boss during Stagger

phases.2.steps.0.text: After Staggering the boss at 557 HP, focus effective damage such as Gloom and Envy on it. Defeating it also removes the remaining henchmen.

phases.2.steps.1.text: At 60% HP or below, Guard becomes a regular Counter. It cannot be offset with a Defense Skill, and the first Sinner to attack takes the counterattack. Check their remaining HP and resistances.

phases.2.steps.2.text: If you accidentally kill a henchman, reassess the extra action and next turn's Haste and Attack Power Up. Do not face the next “Upheaval” with the same plan unchanged.

skills.0.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 3.

skills.0.response.text: Hits build Rupture Potency and Count and also trigger Spiked Bat's extra damage. Win clashes from the opening to prevent Rupture buildup.

skills.1.effects.0.text: [Clash Win] Gain Attack Power Up and 1 Damage Up next turn.

skills.1.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 3.

skills.1.effects.4.text: [On Hit] Inflict Bleed equal to the target's Rupture.

skills.1.response.text: An enemy clash win gives it buffs next turn. Rupture also increases the Bleed inflicted, making the subsequent “Upheaval” dangerous.

skills.2.effects.0.text: If the target has at least 5 Rupture, Clash Power +1.

skills.2.effects.1.text: If the target has at least 5 Bleed, Clash Power +1.

skills.2.effects.5.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Paralyze next turn.

skills.2.effects.6.text: [On Hit] Deal Pierce damage equal to the target's Bleed Potency × Bleed Count.

skills.2.response.text: Stopping this is the highest priority. At least 5 Rupture and at least 5 Bleed each grant +1 Clash Power, and Antagonism may strengthen it further. Coin III deals Pierce damage equal to Bleed Potency × Count, so reserve a strong skill or E.G.O.

skills.3.effects.0.text: [On Use] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.

skills.3.response.text: Gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn On Use. If an attack is targeting this Defense Skill, offset it with a Defense Skill to avoid triggering it unnecessarily.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [On Use] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.

skills.4.response.text: A regular Counter that replaces Guard at 60% HP or below. It cannot be offset with a Defense Skill. Check the first attacking Sinner's resistances and HP, or aim to finish the boss with that attack.

skills.5.response.text: A single-Coin attack that inflicts 4 Rupture. Handle it with a winning clash or Defense Skill rather than strengthening the boss by killing its user.

skills.6.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 3 Rupture Potency, gain +1 Base Power.

skills.6.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down.

skills.6.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down.

skills.6.response.text: Gains +1 Base Power at 3 or more Rupture Potency. It adds Defense Level Down and Rupture Count, so do not let it hit a Sinner with heavy Rupture.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [On Use] Deal 3 SP damage to the target.

skills.7.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Base Power per 4 Rupture Potency, up to 3.

skills.7.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down.

skills.7.response.text: The 3 SP damage On Use applies even if you win the clash. Rupture Potency can grant up to +3 Base Power; hits also inflict Bleed and Paralyze next turn.

skills.8.effects.0.text: If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Final Power.

skills.8.response.text: A regular Counter. Gains +1 Final Power if the target has Rupture and inflicts more Bleed on hit. Do not trigger it carelessly with a weak unopposed attack.

skills.9.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 3.

skills.9.response.text: Adds 3 Rupture Count. Even a single-Coin hit is dangerous on a Sinner who already has high Rupture Potency.

skills.10.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 3 Rupture Count, gain +1 Base Power.

skills.10.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Offense Level Down.

skills.10.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Offense Level Down.

skills.10.response.text: Gains +1 Base Power at 3 or more Rupture Count. Inflicts Offense Level Down and Rupture, weakening later clashes too. Prevent its hits.

skills.11.effects.0.text: [On Use] Deal 3 SP damage to the target.

skills.11.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Base Power per 3 Rupture Count, up to 3.

skills.11.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 4.

skills.11.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Offense Level Down.

skills.11.response.text: Deals 3 SP damage On Use and gains up to +3 Base Power based on Rupture Count. Its Count increases, Bleed, Offense Level Down, and Paralyze compound, so check the current clash prediction and stop it.

skills.12.effects.0.text: If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Final Power.

skills.12.response.text: A regular Counter with +1 Final Power against targets with Rupture. When keeping henchmen alive, avoid hitting them and triggering it.

passives.0.effect.text: Grant 1 Attack Power Up to the 2 other allies with the lowest SP. Each ally death adds 1 slot for the rest of the encounter.

passives.0.response.text: Do not force henchman kills; focus damage on the boss.

passives.1.condition.text: The target's current HP exceeds the user's

passives.1.response.text: Compares current HP values, not HP percentages. Recheck clash predictions against your main attackers as the boss loses HP.

passives.2.effect.text: Heal 5 SP on Clash Win. On Clash Lose against Heathcliff, lose 10 SP and gain 2 Bind next turn (once per turn). If no skill hits Heathcliff during the turn, lose 5 SP at Turn End.

passives.2.response.text: Reserve clashes Heathcliff can win for him. Do not make him handle attacks he cannot beat as well.

passives.3.condition.text: An enemy kills an ally / up to 3 times per turn

passives.3.effect.text: Gain 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Haste next turn.

passives.3.response.text: Avoid strengthening the next turn by killing several henchmen at once.

passives.4.effect.text: Deal additional Pierce damage equal to 50% of the damage dealt.

passives.4.response.text: Blunt resistance alone does not guarantee safety. Win clashes to prevent the hits themselves.

passives.5.condition.text: Turn Start / Turn End / Panic recovery

passives.5.effect.text: At Turn Start, heal 15 SP unless at −45 SP. If Panicked at Turn End, recover next turn and reset SP to 0. If Panic was removed at Turn End, gain 2 Attack Power Up at the next Turn Start.

passives.5.response.text: Lowering SP alone cannot keep the boss disabled. Prepare strong responses for its recovery from Panic.

passives.6.condition.text: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type

passives.6.effect.text: Panic Type does not change; apply effects intended for targets without SP instead.

passives.6.response.text: Do not base the strategy on changing Panic Type.

passives.7.effect.text: Heathcliff Identities' retreat-related functions do not activate.

passives.7.response.text: Do not plan to retreat and swap him out.

passives.8.condition.text: At Combat Start, target is the enemy with the lowest HP

passives.8.response.text: Avoid letting henchman attacks concentrate on wounded Sinners.

passives.9.effect.text: Deal 3 SP damage to the opponent.

passives.9.response.text: Winning still costs SP, but prevents hit-triggered debuffs.

passives.10.response.text: Do not assume Panic will disable them for long.

passives.11.condition.text: At Combat Start, target is the enemy with the lowest HP

passives.11.response.text: Avoid letting henchman attacks concentrate on wounded Sinners.

passives.12.effect.text: Deal 3 SP damage to the opponent.

passives.12.response.text: Winning still costs SP, but prevents hit-triggered debuffs.

passives.13.response.text: Do not assume Panic will disable them for long.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Ally deaths heal the boss for 15 SP and add 1 slot. If a Sinner lands the kill, the boss also gains Attack Power Up and Haste next turn.

mechanics.0.response.text: Keep the henchmen alive and handle their attacks. If killing one, first prepare to handle the extra action.

mechanics.1.effect.text: At 60% HP or below, the boss replaces Guard with a regular Counter.

mechanics.1.response.text: Focus damage during Stagger to reduce the number of counterattacks after it recovers.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Heathcliff is mandatory. He normally gains Bereavement, which lowers SP, but his Wild Hunt Identity gets Unending Bereavement instead.

mechanics.2.response.text: Check how the chosen Identity handles SP, and provide winning clashes and recovery for him.

warnings.0.text: Killing henchmen does not necessarily make the fight easier. Defeating the boss also clears the remaining enemies.

warnings.1.text: Regular Counters cannot be offset with Defense Skills. Do not treat them like Guard before 60% HP.

warnings.2.text: Bringing fewer Sinners can give your main attackers more actions, but reduces total available HP and opening actions. A solo clear is not required from the outset.

warnings.3.text: Do not apply the next encounter's 6-34 defeat condition to this fight.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Lv.44 and Uptie III or higher, with strong opening clashers and a well-developed Heathcliff.

preparation.1.text: Prepare Gloom and Envy damage, strong clash skills, SP recovery, and enemy debuffs. Check whether you can build the required resources from 0.

preparation.2.text: Prioritize Blunt resistance while accounting for the additional Pierce damage, Bleed, and Rupture.

roles.0.reason.text: Compete with the enemy's high SP and stop “Upheaval”.

roles.1.reason.text: Winning clashes against the boss lowers its SP and inflicts Bind. Account for Heathcliff being mandatory and unable to retreat.

roles.2.reason.text: Avoid unnecessary kills while directing damage at the boss.
